card.name: Partway through route and drug words
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces of 'intramuscular' and 'subcutaneous' in dosing instructions, such as 'cular' and 'cut'. Also fires on a few other partway pieces of long medical words like dyskinesias and dexamethasone.

modes.label: Injection route words
modes.description: The middle or end piece of intramuscular or subcutaneous in dosing directions.

modes.label: Other long drug or symptom words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug or symptom name.

modes.label: Effectiveness wording
modes.description: Occasional words about effect or lost effect.
modes.example: experience a fall-off of<< effectiveness>> after a few months

card.writes: It promotes binding-related and odd fragment tokens and suppresses 'safe' words, so the output effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires inside long injection-route words like intramuscular and subcutaneous in dosing text.
